channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Japanese inflation breaks 2% for the first time this year
item.description: The September reading puts pressure on the Bank of Japan to raise rates by the end of the year.

item.title: Japan weighs how to evacuate thousands of tourists if Mount Fuji erupts
item.description: Japan's highest peak is often overlooked as being an active volcano. But with the risk of eruption ever-present, disaster preparedness is key.

item.title: Japanese novelist Ryu Murakami dies at 74
item.description: Murakami's works, which explored sex, violence, and youth culture, were translated globally.

item.title: Shigeru Miyamoto named first video game-related recipient of Japan’s Order of Culture
item.description: The legendary Nintendo figure will be officially conferred with the award in a Nov. 3 ceremony.

item.title: Japan is known for world-class events - but the Asian Games were chaotic
item.description: Hotel chaos, transport mishaps and diplomatic blunders cast a spotlight on organisers and the firm hired to deliver the games.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
